d:
Desh ka sanvidhan 26 navanbar 1949 ko angikrit huaa aur 26 janavri 1950 ko lagu huaa. aaj sanvidhan divas hai aur hamare sanvidhan ki khubsurti bharat ko vishv men mahan banati hai. bihar ke gaya men sanvidhan ki mul prati ki ek pratilipi sahejkar rakhi gaee hai. ise dekhne aur risarch karne dur-dur se log aate hain, jismen mahapurushon ke dastakhat hain.
